title: School completion, Northern Africa and Western Asia, by wealth
headline: Since 2000, primary completion in Northern Africa and Western Asia has risen 15.6 points
subtitle: Percentage of a cohort of children or young people aged 3-5 years above the intended age for the last grade of primary education who have completed primary education
years: From 74.4% in 2000 to 90.0% in 2024: 0.7 points a year.
data_line: Data: UNESCO UIS via UN SDG Global Database, series SE_TOT_CPLR, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Since 2000, primary completion in Northern Africa and Western Asia has risen 15.6 points. From 74.4% in 2000 to 90.0% in 2024: 0.7 points a year. Children completing primary school, Northern Africa and Western Asia: 74.4% in 2000 to 90.0% in 2024.
